title: Local paced PCM WebRTC transport round-trip

methodology.audio: 48 kHz mono, 10 ms PCM pulse followed by silence; timer ends at first returned high-energy PCM frame
methodology.excluded: STT, TTS, LLM, browser rendering, WAN/NAT, natural speech, and AgentSession behavior

topologies.pipecat_smallwebrtc: direct aiortc peer -> Pipecat SmallWebRTC transport -> Pipecat echo processor
topologies.livekit_local_sfu: LiveKit RTC client -> local LiveKit SFU -> direct RTC echo participant

caveat: These are practical alternate transport topologies, not a matched framework or Agents benchmark.
